name: roll upper back
description: Roll your upper back over a foam roller to loosen tight spots and improve thoracic mobility.
instructions: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.
